learning_units.description: Counterclockwise Gebbi circular path with rhythmic handclaps.
Opposing partner stick-tapping in Dandi natana spiral formations.

social_formats.description: Gebbi is danced by groups of women in counterclockwise or concentric circles.
Dandi natana is performed in multiplying paired groups of 2, 4, 8, 16 or more performers.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Synchronized handclapping patterns (Gebbi); tapping wooden sticks against opposing partners' sticks (Dandi natana); expressive comedic gestures (Konangi).
movement_profile.footwork: Circular and spiral walking paths moving counterclockwise, with concentric circles rotating in opposite directions.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Counterclockwise circles around a central lamp or vessel; concentric circles moving in opposite directions when space is constrained; expanding paired formations multiplying from 2 to 4, 8, 16 performers.
movement_profile.partnering: Opposing partner interaction using stick-striking mechanics in Dandi natana.

signature_moves.description: Counterclockwise circular movement accompanied by handclaps around a central vessel or lamp.
signature_moves.name: Gebbi Circle

signature_moves.description: Tapping wooden sticks against a partner's stick on the opposite side within spiral pathways.
signature_moves.name: Dandi Strike

signature_moves.description: Humorous narrative gestures performed by male dancers to re-enact sacred stories.
signature_moves.name: Konangi Jesters Mime

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Starts slowly and gradually increases in speed to a climax.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Do not disrupt the central Thandili Diva or sacred water vessel during Gebbi; avoid careless stick handling during Dandi natana strikes.

music_profile.musical_form: Devotional strophic songs accompanying circular movement, accelerating progressively from a slow start to a fast climax.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Gradually accelerating metric pulses in circle dances; crisp percussive beats generated by striking wooden sticks in partner patterns.
music_profile.sound_description: The sonic environment is characterized by vocal devotional (bhakti) songs sung in chorus, punctuated by synchronized handclaps in Gebbi or the sharp percussive clatter of wood striking wood in Dandi natana.
music_profile.vocal_style: Devotional (bhakti) singing performed either by dancers within the circle or by an external group of singers.

basic_steps: Form a counterclockwise circle around a central lamp or deity image (Gebbi)
Step rhythmically along the circular path while performing synchronized handclaps (Gebbi)
Tap wooden sticks against partner's stick across the formation while moving in circular or spiral paths (Dandi natana)
Execute comic, expressive gestures and humorous spatial movements to convey narrative storytelling (Konangi)
teaching.formation: Concentric or single counterclockwise circles and spirals (Gebbi and Dandi natana); open solo/ensemble performance space (Konangi).
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with basic counterclockwise footwork and handclaps in Gebbi before advancing to stick-striking patterns in Dandi natana or narrative mime in Konangi.
teaching.rhythm: Accelerating tempo in Gebbi (starting slow and increasing in speed); structured periodic beats created by stick strikes in Dandi natana.
